lines.cyr: На пат тргам, војник одам јас
lines.lat: Na pat trgam, vojnik odam jas
lines.en: I set out on the road, I go as a soldier,
I am leaving all of you.

lines.cyr: Мило либе, ти не ме жали, не плачи
lines.lat: Milo libe, ti ne me žali, ne plači
lines.en: Dear love, do not pity me, do not cry,

lines.cyr: солзи не рони, радосно чекај ме.
lines.lat: solzi ne roni, radosno čekaj me.
lines.en: do not shed tears, wait for me joyfully.
The time has come for me to leave,

lines.cyr: Со другари пат не чека нас
lines.lat: So drugari pat ne čeka nas
lines.en: With my comrades the road does not wait for us
